ruleDefinitions.name: Shell Execution via Git - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the "git" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\/git$") AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p\\ .*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*help.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*bash\\ 0\\<\\&1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dash\\ 0\\<\\&1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sh\\ 0\\<\\&1.*")))
